verse.verse_1: No, I swear by this country (Mecca),
verse.verse_2: and you are a lodger in this country.
verse.verse_3: And by the giver of birth, and whom he fathered,
verse.verse_4: We created the human in fatigue.
verse.verse_5: Does he think that none has power over him!
verse.verse_6: He will say: 'I have destroyed a vast wealth'
verse.verse_7: Does he think that none has observed him?
verse.verse_8: Have We not given him two eyes,
verse.verse_10: and guided him on the two paths (of good and evil)?
verse.verse_11: Yet he has not scaled the height.
verse.verse_12: What could let you know what the height is!
verse.verse_13: (It is) the freeing of a slave,
verse.verse_14: the giving of food upon the day of hunger
verse.verse_16: or to a needy person in distress;
verse.verse_17: so that he becomes one of those who believe, charge each other to be patient, and charge each other to be merciful.
verse.verse_18: Those are the Companions of the Right.
verse.verse_19: But those who disbelieve in Our verses, they are the Companions of the Left,
verse.verse_20: with the Fire closed above them.
